messages:
amy_sec: Reminder: vendor pen-test next Fri 09:00-13:00 PT. Need a short intake checklist: RBAC snapshot, KMS-safe upload, evidence manifest, and retest SLA. Keep it minimal.

rahul_ops: I'll own the upload lockbox. Plan: presigned POST to pt-lockbox-prod with bucket-default KMS CMK. No KMS perms for assessors. Lifecycle 30d.

maria_platform: RBAC snapshot approach: run `aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[*].{RoleName:RoleName,Tags:Tags}'` and dump inline policies for in-scope roles; sha256 the output and store in manifests/.

sam_sre: Ephemeral creds via sts-mint scoped to `s3:PutObject` on `pt/<id>/*` and `s3:ListBucket` on the prefix only. Tag minted creds with `pt_id=<id>` for CloudTrail filtering. No kms actions.

omo_kms: Confirm: using bucket default encryption with CMK is best to avoid granting `kms:Encrypt` to assessors. Presigned requests must NOT include SSE-KMS headers.

amy_sec: Evidence naming: `<pt-id>/<assessor>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>_<sha256>.tgz`. Allowed types: tgz, zip, pcap, json. Max single-object 8GB (multipart required >100MB).

opsbot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-1459 "PT intake: lockbox, RBAC snapshot, retest gating" (assignee: rahul_ops; due: 2026-04-22).

maria_platform: Audit export snippet I'll add to ticket: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-04-20T08:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-04-20T16:00:00Z" > cloudtrail.json && tar -czf pt-<id>-archive.tgz cloudtrail.json iam-snapshot.json && sha256sum pt-<id>-archive.tgz > pt-<id>-archive.sha256`.

sam_sre: Retest gating: critical -> emergency retest (48h), high -> 72h mitigation window then retest, medium/low -> schedule 7-14 days. Retest requires PR/commit with verification steps and CI evidence.

amy_sec: Action items: rahul to provision bucket + presign gateway, maria to add IAM snapshot script, omo to confirm CMK policy, sam to ensure pt_id tagging. Dry-run 24h before. Ping me if blocked.
